text:
A night drainage bag (urinary drainage bag) typically ranges from about 2,000 mL to 4,000 mL, with 2,000–2,500 mL being the most common sizes; larger 4,000 mL bags exist for overnight use. Leg bags (500–750 mL) are generally not used for nighttime drainage. Selection depends on expected overnight output and local policy.

CONFIDENCE: 75
